Description: As a customer, I want to view available food items so that I can choose what to order.
As a customer, I want to search for food items so that I can quickly find my desired food.
As a customer, I want to add food items to my cart so that I can order multiple items.
As a customer, I want to remove items from my cart so that I can modify my order.
As a customer, I want to place an order so that the selected food can be delivered to me.
As a customer, I want to receive order confirmation so that I know my order was successfully placed.
As a customer, I want to track my order so that I know the current delivery status.
As a customer, I want to cancel an order so that I can stop an unwanted order.
As a customer, I want to log in so that my account and orders are secure.
As a customer, I want to pay online so that I can complete my order.
As a restaurant owner, I want to manage food items so that I can keep the menu updated.
As a delivery partner, I want to update delivery status so that customers can track their orders.
As an administrator, I want to view orders so that I can monitor the system.
As a customer, I want to provide feedback so that I can rate my food and delivery experience.
As a customer, I want to view previous orders so that I can check my past purchases.
As an administrator, I want the application to respond quickly so that users have a good experience.
As an administrator, I want user data to be secure so that customer information is protected.
As a developer, I want to deploy the application so that customers can access it online.
